name: WEB-PRODUCT-DESIGN
evaluate: first impression, hero section, value proposition, visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, navigation, CTA clarity, trust, pricing, mobile UX, responsive behavior, loading, error states, conversion funnel
never_accept: generic template appearance, placeholder visual hierarchy, weak typography, empty sections, random gradients, poor spacing, desktop-only layouts
description: Web product design skill that evaluates websites as products with business impact, not just technical implementations. Produces concrete design direction before any coding begins.
